_campaign.name: PAK1 alphaC-helix allosteric activator (NMJ actin dynamics, complements PAK4 panel)

_pocket.pdb_title_verified: Structure of phosphorylated PAK1 kinase domain

_rationale.sma_link: PAK1 phosphorylates LIMK1 → cofilin → F-actin at NMJ. Activation stabilizes synaptic F-actin, plausibly rescues SMA NMJ.
_rationale.selectivity_panel: Top 100 → Boltz-2 vs PAK1 + PAK2/3 (Group-I) + PAK4 (Group-II) reference; compare within-PAK selectivity to PAK4 campaign.
_rationale.oncology_caveat: PAK1 hyperactivation oncogenic (breast, colon). Activator is narrow therapeutic-window. First-in-class, highly exploratory. No external surface without Christian sign-off.
